label: D2 rare transition a1->S2 when the agent expects low value
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the shown state is S2 (100% of activations and mass). About 90% of the mass comes from rare transitions after choosing a1 (in_action==1, S2 reached); the remaining ~10% is weaker firing on common a2->S2 steps, mostly when value is low. The bare rare a1->S2 predicate gets F1 0.72 (precision 0.61). Adding the model value-head output (value < 7.6) removes most false positives (dev F1 0.83, P 0.84, R 0.83, mass recall 0.90). Lower value means more firing and larger activations: at value < 7.0, precision is 0.94. Firing also grows over the episode (rate goes from 0.6% of steps in trials 0-9 to 6% in trials 90-99). It never fires at D1 or GO, at S1, or when a reward is input. All variables used are observed at D2; value is the output the agent computes itself, not a future variable.

issues: Every factual claim reproduced. Phase: D1 and GO have 0 activations; D2 has all 32651 dev activations. in_state: S2 holds 100% of the mass and S1 none. in_reward=1 has 0 activations. in_action: a1 has 90.2% of the mass and a2 9.8%. Episode position: 0.6% of steps fire in trials 0-9 and 6.1% in trials 90-99.

Scores reproduced. Dev: rare a1->S2 alone F1 0.717 (precision 0.615); adding value<7.6 gives F1 0.832 (precision 0.836, recall 0.827, mass recall 0.896); value<7.0 gives precision 0.944, recall 0.414. Test: F1 0.811, precision 0.822, recall 0.800, mass recall 0.870.

Residual misses (13% of mass on test) are mostly weak common a2->S2 firing. None of the slices I tried isolates them. With good==1, precision is 0.11. With previous choice a1, precision is 0.23, rising to 0.44 when also value<7.6, but that covers only 6% recall. Adding 'or the previous choice was a1' raises dev F1 only slightly, 0.832 to 0.835, so this is diffuse rather than a systematic gap.

Using the hidden good state instead of value works worse: rare a1->S2 with good==S1 scores F1 0.68. So the value term is doing real work. It is observed, not a future variable (it is the agent's own output at D2).

Episode position adds little once value is in the predicate. Restricting to trials 10 and later barely changes F1 (0.831), and a value threshold that moves with episode trial does not help (F1 0.80). The growth over the episode is mostly explained by value.
